name: After § 20
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text: 20a. Reaffirms its support for the Belarusian people and their right to political and economic self-determination; condemns any potential external interference with the right of the Belarusian people to live peacefully and in accordance with their right to self-determination;
